solution: Under 'Computers' the chapter states: "In 1988, the Central Government established the Centre for Development for Advanced Computing (C-DAC) in Pune and in 1991 the Centre under the leadership of Dr Vijay Bhatkar developed the Param-8000 supercomputer." Dr R. H. Dave chaired the committee on minimum levels of learning (Competency based Primary Education Curriculum 1995) and P. Parthasarathy chaired the 1974 committee that led to IGNOU — both are education-administration figures in this same chapter, not the supercomputer's developer.

Under 'Engineering' the chapter says of the IIT: "The objective of this institute was that higher and advanced education in all branches of engineering should be available in India", and notes the engineering colleges at Powai, Chennai, Kanpur and New Delhi were converted into IITs. Option (c) 'skilled managers' is the tempting rival because the very next paragraph says the Indian Institute of Management was started "to mould skilled managers" — that is the IIM, not the IIT.
